assets.name: Ashlar Wall
assets.description: 4 m bays with independently bonded faces over a mortar core. Origin at the base center.

evidence.art: Varied pitched saddle coping and four-metre sockets. Long courses remain repetitive in context.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 03 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Vaulted Gateway
assets.description: 2.68 m clear opening. Full-depth voussoirs with cut-to-curve spandrel courses. Origin at threshold center.

evidence.art: Deeper entry reads in the same light rig; wing-wall fit still needs a corner-specific joint.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 03 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Limestone Stair
assets.description: 3.6 m-wide route. Nine 0.18 m risers and 0.34 m treads. Origin at first riser.

evidence.art: Cap returns into landing and nine treads pass. Cheek-to-tread joints need further close-up refinement.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 03 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Faulted Limestone Escarpment
assets.description: Continuous sedimentary bench with dipping strata, eroded joints and a foundation shelf. Local Z=0 at the foot.

evidence.art: One fitted manifold foundation below the showcase; 42 walk samples clear. Abrupt ledges remain visible on its exposed face.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 03 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3. Isolated GLB also passed.

assets.name: Honed Limestone
assets.description: Image-backed pale cut-stone finish. 1.35 m UV repeat for architectural modules.

evidence.art: Darker scanned mineral bedding, roughness contrast and controlled cool/warm grades under neutral and grazing keys.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 03 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3.

assets.name: Irregular Stone Court
assets.description: Continuous paved formation with staggered sett courses. Origin at center of walking plane.

evidence.art: Lower flagstones sit over a continuous foundation. Front edge remains too straight for exposed ruin terrain.
evidence.godot: Imported in the refinement 03 showcase on Hollowmark Godot 4.6.3.
